menu_option_descriptions.media_favorites: TIDAL accounts and TuneIn sources are discovered automatically. Configure optional TIDAL playlists and TuneIn favorites.
menu_option_descriptions.recreate_entity_ids: Apply Home Assistant's current automatic naming format to every entity in this Control4 integration entry.

media_favorites.title: Control4 options
media_favorites.description: TIDAL accounts and TuneIn sources are discovered automatically. Director does not expose their dynamic playlist/favorite lists to this integration, so optional playable items use: TIDAL source name | playlist name | playlist UUID; TuneIn source name | favorite name | Station/id. Entries appear only in rooms where that source is available.

recreate_entity_ids.title: Recreate all Control4 entity IDs?

error.invalid_tidal_playlists: Use: source name | playlist name | UUID, with a valid UUID and no duplicate names per source
error.invalid_tunein_favorites: Use: source name | favorite name | Station/id, with a valid station ID and no duplicate names per source

abort.entity_ids_already_current: All Control4 entity IDs already use Home Assistant's current automatic naming format.
abort.entity_ids_recreated: Recreated {count} Control4 entity IDs. Update any dashboard, automation, script, or scene references that used the old IDs.
